user.title: Cycle settings
user.description: Enter the basics of your cycle. You can change these later in the integration options.

data.notification_offset_days: Days before the period to send a notification

data.notification_time: Time of day to send notifications

sheet.title: Google Sheet
sheet.description: Connect a Google Sheet that will hold your cycle history. Paste the spreadsheet ID from the sheet's URL, enter the worksheet (tab) name, and give the path to your service-account key file as it sits inside your Home Assistant configuration directory. Share the spreadsheet with the service account as an Editor: {client_email}

data.spreadsheet_id: Spreadsheet ID (the long identifier in the sheet's URL)
data.worksheet: Worksheet name (tab). A new Google Sheet names its first tab Sheet1 — or Arkusz1 in a Polish-language account.
data.service_account_file: Service account key file path (inside your config directory, e.g. service_account.json)
data.poll_interval: How often to check the sheet for changes (minutes)

import_offer.title: Import cached periods
import_offer.description: Local cycle history was found. Import it into the empty sheet now? A sheet that already has rows always wins, so the import must happen before any rows are added.

data.import_cached_periods: Import cached periods into the sheet

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate with Google. Check the service-account key file and that the account is shared as an Editor of the spreadsheet.
error.sheet_not_found: Spreadsheet or worksheet not found. Check the IDs and sharing.
error.invalid_range: The worksheet (tab) name was not found, or the spreadsheet ID is malformed. Check the tab name exactly — a Polish Google Sheet names its first tab Arkusz1 — and paste only the long ID from the sheet URL, not the whole URL.
error.invalid_schema: The worksheet header is missing required columns.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Google Sheets. Check the key file path and network.
error.invalid_spreadsheet_id: The spreadsheet ID is not valid. Paste only the long ID from the sheet URL — the part between /d/ and /edit — not the whole address.

sheet_not_configured.title: Google Sheet not configured
sheet_not_configured.description: Cycle Tracker needs a Google Sheet to store your period history. Open the integration options and enter the spreadsheet, worksheet and service-account key file path.

sheet_auth_failed.title: Google Sheet authentication failed
sheet_auth_failed.description: Cycle Tracker could not authenticate with Google Sheets. Verify the service-account key file and that the service account is shared as an Editor of the spreadsheet.

sheet_unreachable.title: Google Sheet unreachable
sheet_unreachable.description: Cycle Tracker could not reach Google Sheets. Check the network connection and that the spreadsheet and worksheet exist.

sheet_schema_invalid.title: Google Sheet header is invalid
sheet_schema_invalid.description: The worksheet is missing one or more required columns. Update the header row before the integration can sync.

sheet_rows_invalid.title: Google Sheet contains invalid rows
sheet_rows_invalid.description: Cycle Tracker ignored {count} invalid row(s) in the worksheet. Review the sheet for missing start dates or rows that end before they start.
